# Configuration

## Options

| Name   | Type   | Default |
|--------|--------|---------|
| format | string | llm     |
| style  | bool   | false   |

## Commands

| Command  | Description        | Exit Codes |
|----------|--------------------|------------|
| lint     | Run all checks     | 0, 2      |
| refs     | List references    | 0, 2      |
| headers  | Extract headings   | 0         |
| stats    | Show statistics    | 0         |
| toc      | Generate TOC       | 0         |
